description:
Batch-fetch multiple Zendesk tickets by their IDs.

Fetches up to thousands of tickets in a single call using the Zendesk Show Many API.
Automatically batches requests when more than 100 IDs are provided (API limit is 100 per request).

Returns all found tickets plus a list of any IDs that were not found.
Duplicate and invalid (non-positive) IDs are automatically filtered out.

Use include_comments to also fetch comments for each ticket. WARNING: This makes one additional API request per ticket, so avoid using it with large sets (>50 tickets) to prevent rate limiting.

Example: Get tickets 101, 102, 103 with their comments:
{ "ids": [101, 102, 103], "include_comments": true }

ids.description: Array of ticket IDs to fetch (non-empty)

include_comments.description: Fetch comments for each ticket (default: false). WARNING: Makes one API call per ticket

output_path.description: Custom file name for the export (only used when save_to_file is true). Only the file name is honoured: the export is created inside a fresh private directory under the system temp directory and the full path is returned as file_path. The path must resolve inside the system temp directory.

response_format.description: Response format: "concise" (default) for summary, "detailed" for full ticket data

save_to_file.description: Write results to a JSON file instead of returning in context. Required when fetching more than 100 tickets.

subdomain.description: Zendesk subdomain (optional if only one account connected)

name: get_zendesk_tickets_by_ids
